# NeoStation English UI strings
# Source: lib/l10n/app_locale_en.dart (map appLocaleEn), keys from lib/l10n/app_locale.dart
# Repo: misobadev/neostation-frontend, commit d9bece5
# Format: AppLocale.<identifier> [<key string>] = <English value>. Grouped by the section comments in app_locale.dart.
# {name}-style placeholders are substituted at runtime. \n is a literal newline in the value.
# Note: 6 em dashes in the source (section headers, and one \u2014 in screen_return_access_desc) were rewritten as " - " here; check the source if the exact glyph matters.
